_readme: Publish this file where GitHub Pages actually SERVES it — beside launch/docs/index.html, so it resolves at https://nkcourses.github.io/trace_updates/updates.json. That is the FIRST feed js/build-config.js tries. At the repo root it 404s and the panel silently falls through to raw.githubusercontent. The panel shows a notice only when `latest` is HIGHER than the running version, compared number by number, so bump `latest` when you PUBLISH a release and not before.
headline: Trace 1.0 — every use of a clip, across every sequence, selected at once.
notes: Merged clips are now identified correctly, and their audio channels count as one use rather than one per channel.
The background re-scan backs off properly on slow projects instead of running flat out.
Deselecting a clip now clears the summary, so the panel never shows numbers for a clip you are no longer looking at.
